item.title: CV
item.description:
Ed Frost

Senior Consultant | Endpoint Management Architect | PowerShell Automation Expert

Driving Innovation, Fleet Health & Enterprise Automation

Technical Specializations

  • PowerShell Automation: Advanced scripting, error handling, robust script architecture, reusable modules, crash dump analysis, Microsoft Graph API integration

  • Endpoint Management: Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM), Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Software Center, OS Deployment (OSD), PSADT

  • System Configuration: Windows 10/11, Group Policy (GPO), OS hardening, desktop imaging, compliance baselines

  • Reporting & Dashboards: Power BI, custom web/PowerShell compliance dashboards, real-time fleet telemetry

  • Environments & Tools: Azure AD / Entra ID, Windows Server, VMware Horizon, Visual Studio Code, AdminStudio, Ivanti, JAMF, AirWatch, GitHub
